design.name: 三青鸟
design.brief: One of the three azure birds (三青鸟) of the Queen Mother of the West on Kunlun, frozen into a hovering ranged attacker: a big elegant azure-blue bird with a wingspan of about 3.5 m, a red crest, a sharp white beak, three very long trailing tail plumes, every flight feather edged with a band of pale ice like a blade, and a large glowing cyan frost jewel set in the middle of its chest (weak spot). Thin strong legs with four clawed toes each, tucked when flying. Proud, cold and graceful.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized head and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted crystal shapes (never thin needles or noisy frost texture), fur as a few large carved clumps. Feathers are big simple carved shapes, not fine strands.
design.turnaround_lead: Symmetric flying bind pose for rigging:
design.turnaround_pose: hovering in a symmetric T-pose: both wings spread fully and horizontally to the sides, straight and level, flight feathers fanned out; the body level, the head facing straight ahead with the beak closed; the three long tail plumes trailing straight back and slightly down; both legs hanging down below the body with the toes relaxed and open; the chest jewel painted as opaque bright cyan (no halo); feathers as big simple carved shapes
design.turnaround_digits: each foot with four separate clawed toes; both wingtips and all three tail plumes fully inside the frame (the wingspan is widest in the front and back views, keep generous margin).
